notes.title: Our latest cyberpunk visual novel released! :)
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce our latest cyberpunk visual novel Crystal Chameleon:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/989110/Crystal_Chameleon/
Meet Jackie - a freelance negotiator who's best friend is a cyber dolphin. Accompany her in an adventure she didn't really ask for. Solve a mystery and maybe make some new friends along the way.

notes.title: We brought all chapters together into one game & part 3 is out! :D
notes.notes:
Dear friends :) I'm glad to announce that we finalized the major update of Invisible Apartment 1 which we were working on for a long time. You're now able to play part 0, 1, 2 and the new part 3 from within the same game as DLCs.

If you already purchased Invisible Apartment 2 as a separate game than we'll give you the keys for the new DLC for free - just follow the guide at http://steamcommunity.com/app/351790/discussions/0/348293292497416125/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/543220/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/532060/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/543230/

We also have a bundle which is really affordable at http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1766/

notes.title: Invisible Apartment 3 Kickstarter now live!
notes.notes:
Dear friends! :)

We have just relaunched the crowdfunding campaign for Invisible Apartment 3. After months of production it now features much more content and a new platform in the works.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vysoko/invisible-apartment-3

We would be very happy to have you as a backer :) This will be the part of the series which finalizes the whole story, so don't miss out the opportunity to be part of those who helped complete this visual novel series.
